🎉 🎤  New Syng.Rocks! version 2.4.1:

Finally, after what felt like an eternity, a new version of Syng.Rocks!

Major highlights are:
    - Updated yt-dlp
    - Lots of UI and UX improvement. Now every configuration option is explained in the UI
    - Pause music
    - Cleaner webui
    
With the new release pipeline, you can expect more frequent updates.
